description: Formal Project Cloak threat model: 14 leak vectors enumerated with mitigation, verification test, and residual risk for each. Audit procedure specified. Locked alongside Rung 6 of pre-release hardening sprint.
leak_vectors: 2.4 Identifier in API request metadata (headers, schemas, user-agent)
2.8 File path leakage in region mode
2.10 Plaintext fallback on internal error (fail-closed invariant)
out_of_scope_documented: Side-channel inference (timing, token count, model selection)
Adversaries with access to operator's GitHub clone or backups
Pattern-match attacks using prior real-name vocabulary
Cross-run inference (mitigated by per-instance symbol map rotation)
verifying_runs: SWE-bench B-Cloaked (Rosetta OFF): 1,813,760 identifiers verified across 300 instances, zero leaks
invariants: Every leak vector has a mitigation, a verifying test or audit, and an explicit residual-risk rating
Out-of-scope items are enumerated explicitly so operators do not over-claim
Audit procedure is repeatable and produces a machine-checkable artifact (verify_cloak.py exit code + leak count)
Map files (cloak_map_*.json) are .gitignored and treated as host secrets
Tool schema names must come from closed vocabulary (operator-discipline requirement, documented)
Plaintext fallback on internal error is forbidden (fail-closed invariant, unit-tested)
